cohort: 70 COVID-19 positive pregnant women admitted to a tertiary care center between May 2020 and January 2021.
finding: COVID-19 infection in pregnancy presented as a milder disease in most cases, but could be severe in those with comorbidities.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean delivery was performed in 41.5% of the participants, while 30% delivered vaginally.
birth_weight: Low birth weight in 18% of newborns
